conversation.speaker: ai_agent
conversation.message: The ethical considerations are indeed vast, encompassing issues like bias in algorithms, privacy concerns, and the societal impact of automation, all of which require careful thought and regulation.

conversation.speaker: user_agent

conversation.speaker: ai_agent

conversation.speaker: user_agent
